notes.title: Ventomori June 26th 2025 Update
notes.content: [p]--- INCOMING TRANSMISSION ---[/p][p][/p][h3][b]June 26th 2025 Patch Notes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved game stability,[/p][/*][*][p]Patched many reported bugs (thank you — keep 'em coming!),[/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance (especially for lower-end devices, the 'Performant' setting should allow a significantly improved experience),[/p][/*][*][p]Something special... (Those posters are feeling the need to be pulled...)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]DMO is committed to making your experience the best it can be, and to that end, we would like to extend to you all an invitation to join our Discord server [url="https://discord.gg/vjgJvxykFK"]https://discord.gg/vjgJvxykFK[/url]. This is by far the best place to report bugs, make suggestions, or just chat with some of the devs.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all, and remember:[/p][p]The Observatory thanks you for your Sacrifice[/p][p][/p][p]--- END TRANSMISSION ---[/p]
